about: How deep each pair of models goes into the other where the builders seat them, on the models' triangles: mm (the overlap's thickness) and mm3 (the volume both fill, 2 mm grid). Written by tools/seats.mjs; src/engine/physical.js holds every pair to its seat. Each seat over the skin is an open model fault: docs/physics_rework.md, round 4. Measured 2026-11-10 on 76 tracks (sweep seeds 1 to 2, the fixtures and VTech's layouts).
